description: Make a page's current draft blocks and layout the published version the public delivery API serves. Re-publishing an already published page pushes its newer draft changes. Until a page is published the site answers 404 for it. Reverse with unpublish_page; drop unpublished edits with revert_to_published. Page settings such as slug and SEO are not part of a publish. Returns the page id and any blockWarnings.

pageId.description: Page id or slug to publish

name: publish_page
title: Publish page
